title: Politics chat: Trump's $5,000 promise to voters, Vance invokes Charlie Kirk
description: Following the midterm convention in Dallas, President Trump's $5,000 campaign promise has generated attention, but not belief. And, Vice President JD Vance characterizes Democrats as extremists.

title: The Social Security trust fund is running out. Why is it not a top campaign issue?
description: Limited public discussion of the trust fund's shortfall has experts worried that most Americans don't fully understand the problems Social Security faces — or weigh in on solutions.

title: How a young woman became an ISIS bride — and then an informant, helping save others
description: A young Canadian mother shares her memories of being an ISIS bride, and her harrowing escape from the extremist group.

title: Alien Terrorist Removal Court deports legal US resident to Afghanistan in first-ever case
description: Nazira Haji Zada, a lawful permanent resident, conceded to being an "alien terrorist." It marks the first case in the Alien Terrorist Removal Court.

title: Democrats and Republicans can agree: there should be more monetary support for child care
description: The Trump administration is eyeing a proposal to give childcare subsidies to married couples with a stay-at-home parent. Some Democrats have a similar proposal, with one major difference.

title: President Trump to meet with Irish president and prime minister
description: President Trump is working in some Irish diplomacy as he attends a golf tournament at his club in Doonbeg.

title: Week in politics: Trump attends Republican midterm convention and Pentagon's 9/11 memorial service
description: President Trump attended a 9/11 memorial service at the Pentagon on Friday after speaking on both nights of a Republican gathering in Dallas.

title: Neighbor turned on neighbor after Charlie Kirk's killing. Is the divide here to stay?
description: The assassination of far right activist Charlie Kirk opened the floodgates of neighbor-on-neighbor doxing. A year later, the damage to political discourse in the U.S. remains.

title: Ethics watchdogs await RFK Jr.'s financial report
description: Health Secretary RFK Jr.'s annual financial disclosure is late. When it posts, the public could learn how much he has earned from a vaccine-related lawsuit against Merck, which RFK now regulates.

title: Mayor of the 'Air Capital of the World' reacts to Trump's threats against Bombardier
description: NPR's Sacha Pfeiffer talks with Wichita Mayor Lily Wu about President Trump's tariff war with Canada, Bombardier aircrafts, and the trade war's potential impact on her city.
